timing_commitment_version_policy: Do not conflate dream occurrence,first record,entry lock,event occurrence,event publication,event discovery,judge lock orfeedback. Unknowns remain unknown;original timezone strings preserved.

A dream entered after the event butbeforeparticipantdiscovery is not automatically a prediction of event occurrence. Label information-timing claims separately from future-event claims;require a declared study endpoint.
Lock original raw narrative before eligible outcome knowledge. Later corrections append a new version linked to original;post-outcome versions cannot retroactively become prospective evidence.

Hash chains andnonce commitments can detect recorded-byte mismatches against an independently retained anchor. A local timestamp does not establish when a dream occurred orwhen an entry was actually written;owner can rewrite all local history.
Require event-window andcriteria commitments before search orreveal;reject posthoc window expansion ornew target universes while retaining a valid prespecified designation.
Retain every planned slot,nonrecall,unsubmitted/late entry,abort,failed comparison andexclusion. Do not silently select remembered dreams orsuccessful event searches.
blinding_and_leakage_policy: Separate participant/private diary andevent mapping from neutral judge packets. Remove target labels,answer flags,filenames,captions andunnecessary revealing chronology from blind material while retaining original dates in private evidence.
Precommit judge assignment,candidate presentation,criteria andrating scale before exposure. Lock all planned judges before reveal;preserve disagreement without selecting best judge.
If time-relative chronology is the tested endpoint,define which dates are masked andwhich comparator information the judge needs. Do not blindly strip information required by the prespecified task.
Known events,public news,prior knowledge andparticipant search behavior may defeat psychological blinding even withclean exported fields. Declare operational separation andwitnessing truthfully.

Independent blind matching is feasible only for a defined candidate universe withappropriate controls. Open personal-life narratives are descriptive associations unless a separate validated comparison design exists.
Future event assets/text require permission-cleared local snapshots. No cloud,scraping-every-news-item,imagegen,paidAPI ornew model is required for the first ledger subset.

bias_and_chance_safeguards.retrospective_reconstruction: Preserve original entry,versions,known-at-record information andlater commentary separately. An apparently precise edited account does not replace an earlier vague record.
bias_and_chance_safeguards.unrecorded_dreams: Predeclare capture schedule andretain missing/nonrecall entries;do not treat remembered successes as the denominator.
bias_and_chance_safeguards.selective_event_search: Name the event universe,collector,collection window andsearch budget before searching. Log every event/pair/search attempt;no open-ended best match selection.
bias_and_chance_safeguards.ambiguous_wording: Freeze match features before outcome;preserve original granularity anduncertainty. Retrospective free association is commentary,not newly prespecified specificity.
bias_and_chance_safeguards.one_to_many: Track all dream-event pairs,not only top similarities. Multiple candidate events,windows,features andjudges create multiple comparisons;no automaticindependenttestcount.
bias_and_chance_safeguards.common_events: Record base-rate categories,duplicate stories andrecurring personal events. Common lectures,visits orspills do not share one uniform probability.
bias_and_chance_safeguards.window_selection: Explicit timezone/interval boundaries andlate discovery policy;no widening windows after seeing a potential match.
bias_and_chance_safeguards.semantic_models: No trained/tuned embeddings orLLM scoring certified as a historical orvalidated dream metric. Any retrieval feature would require held-out evaluation andprespecified use;not initial core.
bias_and_chance_safeguards.feedback: Feedback caninfluence later entries andsearch;retain sequence andpre/post-feedback cohorts rather than assuming independence.
bias_and_chance_safeguards.independence: Repeated dreams,shared news,recurring events,overlapping windows andmultiplejudges are dependent. No naive binomial,p-value ornormal-error claim without an independently verified design.
bias_and_chance_safeguards.null_model: No universal dream-match probability.43top-rank1/5 andexpectedrank3apply only under that specific fixed five-choice uniform design;they do not transfer toopen dream/event matching.
bias_and_chance_safeguards.evidence: One match orhigh similarity cannot establish precognition. Descriptive capture,chronology andblind rating integrity remain distinct from causal/paranormal inference.
